zstd_level.description: Zstandard compression level (1-22); -1 = default (or use legacy compression if set)

split_size_mb.description: Split archive into volumes of this size (MB); 0 = no split

jobs.description: Number of compression threads. Default is 1.

crypt_password.description: Encryption password (6-64 chars); empty = no encryption. ⚠️ Avoid storing passwords in config files.

allow_rw_mounted.description: Allow saving read-write mounted filesystems (live backup)

allow_no_acl_xattr.description: Skip failure when ACL/xattr support is missing

exclude_patterns.description: List of exclude patterns (shell wildcards accepted)

mkfs.description: Default filesystem type for restfs conversion (e.g., 'ext4')

new_uuid.description: New filesystem UUID on restore (empty = preserve original)
